eval_cases_dir.description: Optional repository-relative case directory, matching the eval YAML dataset.path. For case-only changes, pass changed directory names as --cases; otherwise run the full dataset. Does not add implicit triggers.

max_turns.description: Outer Claude orchestrator turn limit, matching EVAL_MAX_TURNS. Per-case turn limits require harness support.

path.description: Normalized repository-relative path (no absolute path, backslash, control character, empty component, . or ..). A trailing slash denotes a directory prefix. The runner also checks file existence, containment, and config uniqueness.
